_about: Public-domain Asa Mahan (1799-1889, first president of Oberlin, Wesleyan holiness writer) for the Word Hoard: Doctrine of the Will (Project Gutenberg, 1845), and from Internet Archive scans Scripture Doctrine of Christian Perfection (1839), The True Believer (1847), Lectures on the Ninth of Romans (1850), Modern Mysteries Explained and Exposed (1855), The Science of Natural Theology (1867), The Baptism of the Holy Ghost (1870), Out of Darkness into Light (1875), The Phenomena of Spiritualism (1875) and his Autobiography (1882). His philosophy textbooks are alternates. Oberlin perfectionism; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 19 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
